journey.name: widgets intro
journey.description: Precondition: onboarded dev wallet, widgets enabled, widgets intro unseen, and Bitcoin Weather NOT already in the widget set. A new wallet's default set already has it, and re-saving a widget that is already there keeps its original position instead of appending, so the final assertion fails for the wrong reason. Delete it from the widgets list first if present.

actions.action: Verify the widgets intro screen (id "WidgetsOnboarding") is visible showing "Hello, Widgets" (the heading renders in capitals), "View & Organize", and "Add Widget"
Tap "Add Widget" (id "WidgetsOnboardingAddWidget") — this also marks the intro as seen, so the journey cannot be repeated without resetting hasSeenWidgetsIntro
Verify the "Add Widget" sheet is visible with "Bitcoin Price" and "Bitcoin Weather"
Verify the widgets intro remains visible behind the sheet backdrop at the top
Verify the sheet navigates to "Bitcoin Weather" and "Save Widget" (id "WidgetSave") is visible
Verify the wallet overview widgets section is visible
Verify "Bitcoin Weather" appears as the last widget in the current widget set
